extraction.introduction:
These people shouldn’t make policy.

There has been a great effort over many years to distance AI Safety discussion from its origin and intellectual center, because its center is a predatory sex cult started by a fan fiction author. Since those involved want to be taken seriously, they have to hide that. Everyone else working in AI Safety is, effectively, a smokescreen for this core group and their ideas.

We might some day have “AI Safety”, as a science or policy area, that is not primarily a sex cult in Berkeley, California, but it does not currently exist.

parts.title: Yudkowsky's influence on AI figures and companies
parts.text:
Yudkowsky is sufficiently controversial that people motivated by his ideas often downplay or deny his influence. Sometimes this spans multiple layers: People who received money from Sam Bankman-Fried denying they’re Effective Altruists, Sam Bankman-Fried denying he’s an Effective Altruist when caught, Effective Altruists denying their version of AI Safety is heavily influenced by Yudkowsky’s, people literally attending the same orgies as Yudkowsky passing themselves off as merely “rationalist adjacent”, and so on. But Yudkowsky is provably, publicly influential on essentially all major public figures in AI. It is easy to deny not because it is hidden but because it seems so insane.

Yudkowsky is the person who connected Shane Legg and Demis Hassabis to Peter Thiel so that they could secure funding to start DeepMind1, which is now Google's AI research division. Here's Sam Altman's opinion of Yudkowsky.

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!H028!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fa3f7ffc8-9cb7-4e8f-b63a-ba1082397cf9_601x369.webp]]

This is the schedule for the Future of Life Institute's conference on AI in Puerto Rico in January, 2015. Elon Musk would found OpenAI that December. So it seems plausible that his attendance did influence the founding of OpenAI.

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!UndY!,w_720,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F0ee0e1c4-ebd1-45eb-ba3d-d6059212ae16_1006x869.webp]]

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!mJH4!,w_720,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Ffe96400d-1779-4a7e-ac01-bbeedce16d82_2048x1366.jpeg]]

Dario Amodei, current CEO of Anthropic, is here in 2013 identified as a "member of the Effective Altruism community" on the blog of Yudkowsky's non-profit.

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!36ZH!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Ff5fef854-ecd8-4ddc-abdb-c97feb2c0888_633x724.webp]]

And here he is arguing about the paperclip maximizer, a now-classic thought experiment, originally Yudkowsky’s, about an AI that might kill everyone.

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!55-W!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fa1fdcc51-598c-498d-ac45-ffd7c142c557_682x507.webp]]

“AI Alignment” and “AI Safety” were first popularized by Yudkowsky’s non-profit, MIRI, the Machine Intelligence Research Institute. OpenAI and Anthropic have cited Yudkowsky or his non-profit at least a dozen times, and the entire way we talk about AI uses terminology his non-profit popularized. It is effectively impossible to even discuss these areas without, implicitly or explicitly, performing commentary on Yudkowsky’s writing.

This is Jacob Coxon, the recent “whistleblower” who quit Anthropic, being asked his opinions on rationalists and effective altruists.

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!gVex!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fb227fdfe-9928-4950-ad8e-706d383fa40b_1320x1826.webp]]

This is Nate Silver citing LessWrong as a source of major information about AI risk. LessWrong is a website started by Yudkowsky in 2009, and originally filled only with his writing.

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!Y0w8!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F563d0a3b-1bfb-486b-bc1c-ab9d403ae041_1024x612.webp]]

This is Oliver Habryka, who runs the nonprofit controlling LessWrong and the rationalist’s compound, known as Lighthaven, explaining how large he thinks the influence of rationalism is on AI Safety and AI existential risk discourse. He is engaged in some kind of internal territorial dispute here. It is possibly the only time I have ever agreed with him.

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!VySh!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F478b45fd-d206-4e0b-b481-04fd24422216_602x502.png]]

This is a podcast interview with Daniel Alejandro Moreno-Gama, who attempted to firebomb Sam Altman’s house, in which he names Yudkowsky as his primary influence.

parts.title: Rationalists and their link to Bay Area Effective Altruism
parts.text:
Yudkowsky’s more dedicated followers seem to prefer to call themselves “the rationality community” these days, everyone else calls them “rationalists”, the entire following “rationalism”. I generally prefer “rats”.

This is a long denial that they are a religion. I alternate between finding it funny and finding it insulting.

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!RX23!,w_474,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F370a95bd-5121-4c4d-a743-e39d16e72ed5_596x943.webp]]

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!OKuy!,w_474,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Ffd64a89c-fe12-4474-9660-2c33bc536b3e_596x1036.webp]]

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!bfVD!,w_474,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F85c9feff-87e7-41d4-aa62-d954216a4951_596x1045.webp]]

The fan fiction that launched a thousand cults is Harry Potter and the Methods of Rationality, or HPMOR. It is possibly the highest-impact single modern religious text, rivalled only by the Book of Mormon. Its influence may not yet have peaked. It is the holy book of the first great internet cult.

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!-8KA!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fb50da4ef-20d7-4b6d-aecb-0689f9c6b3c3_247x403.jpeg]]

Harry Potter and the Methods of Rationality

How Are Rationalists Connected To The Bay Area Effective Altruists?

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!Ujdt!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F6ee4aa89-eb11-4953-ba7a-19abf01edb65_1024x421.webp]]

Bay Area Effective Altruism meetup’s banner photo. Can you spot Yudkowsky?

Allegedly, Effective Altruism and its AI safety efforts are a separate thing and not directly beholden to Yudkowsky. This is fundamentally not true. Effective Altruism in the Bay Area has almost perfect overlap with rationalism, and the Effective Altruist AI Safety people in the Bay set the agenda for the rest of Effective Altruism’s safety efforts.

In the Bay Area, Rationalism and Effective Altruism are the same people, at the same events, in the same places, who believe the things said by the same authors and leaders, with only very slight differences between spheres of influence. Yudkowsky called himself an effective altruist and a rationalist until a peculiar internal schism. Scott Alexander, the second-most influential writer in the space, has usually called himself both. They generally work for the same companies and non-profits.

Frequently, Effective Altruists bring up all of Effective Altruism’s other charitable activities and its charming, benevolent members who don’t live in the Bay Area to deflect true criticisms of the Bay Area Effective Altruist community. This effectively makes their other charitable operations and workers shields and fronts for the priorities and behavior of the Effective Altruists in the Bay Area, who are interested almost exclusively in AI.

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!IFdc!,w_720,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F47721897-9ae7-4133-9088-ece075e8e17b_1280x639.webp]]

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!BbEA!,w_720,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F72d70f7e-ceeb-40a2-9145-4ea7fb2407ac_1280x1067.webp]]

Where there is any separation between the two things in the Bay, “rationalism” is people and things more closely tied to Yudkowsky, and “effective altruism” has had a few institutional centers but is currently focused around Anthropic and its CEO, Dario Amodei. They compete for attention and funding in that space. Yudkowsky’s position is that AI will definitely kill us, and Dario’s position is that AI is ten to twenty-five percent likely to kill us.

Both are saying what justifies giving them and no one else money, labor and attention. Since Yudkowsky is a writer and not a scientist of any kind, he can only claim that he and his organization are important and deserve money and prestige if AI Safety is an unsolvable problem and only advocating against AI matters. Since Dario leads a company that actually makes AI, he must claim that AI doom is a very large problem that only his company can manage.

Yudkowsky also claimed that his (non-profit) company was probably the only one that could make AI safely, back when AI companies seldom made anything and he could claim to be doing research by simply writing. This belief system has been strenuously improved for, among other things, being a pitch to investors, donors, volunteers and employees. It is also a pitch for people to give you total control over them, because if they do not, the world might end. After Yudkowsky refined this pitch and mostly used it to form a sex cult, modifications of it became the pitch for organizations like OpenAI and Anthropic, and this is integral to employee morale and recruiting because so many research staff are believers to one degree or another.

Yudkowsky is not going to stop preaching the gospel of doom, among other reasons because he is effectively paid for it and it is the only job he has ever had. He would stand to lose his social position and the roughly 600k in income he is paid out of his non-profit if he changed his tune. In general, if doom prophecies are worth money, people will produce more. This system’s purpose is to attract funding and young idealists and to find ways to spend the funding and make use of the young idealists. One of the ways that young idealists are made use of is by using them for sex, or introducing them to sex work.

People tend to follow their incentives.

parts.title: Anthropic, EA-funded organizations and policy influence
parts.text:
People sometimes deny that Anthropic is an Effective Altruist organization. This is a complete lie. Dario cheerfully identified as an Effective Altruist and debated about AI with Yudkowsky. Holden Karnofsky, Ben Mann, Daniela Amodei, Amanda Askell, and Jack Clark and Tom Brown are all Effective Altruists and have affiliated themselves with Effective Altruist pledges and causes.

Dario in particular is almost perfectly on-type for a Bay Area Effective Altruist in what he says and how he says it. Dario’s often bizarre, vague, and meandering writing style alone has no real precedent besides LessWrong and its AI-focused spinoff, Alignment Forum. Their company’s strategy is very close to the playbook Yudkowsky laid out, back before companies which were actually capable of doing science removed any credibility Yudkowsky’s organization had when it claimed to do AI research.

This same thing happens when it comes to the incestuous relationships between all of the other non-profits in the Bay that are meant to be focused on AI risk. They all have one of a few sources of funding and they recruit from the movement. Holden Karnofsky, currently Anthropic, formerly head of Coefficient Giving, was an original board member of Redwood Research and one of the initial champions for METR. Both are held up as independent organizations and are not. Redwood mostly seems to be trying to catch the same lightning in a bottle that Yudkowsky had with MIRI in inspiring devotion, to avoid behaving in any of the obviously disgraceful ways Yudkowsky is prone, and to launder essentially the same world view into policy papers that can be cited and pointed to as having come from a serious organization.

In the video with Bernie Sanders, the present people are:

Eliezer Yudkowsky, MIRI

Nate Soares, MIRI

Jeffrey Ladish (funded by Coefficient Giving, an EA charity)

Daniel Kokotajlo (funded by Survival and Flourishing Fund, an EA charity)

So when they go to get people to talk to a senator we have Yudkowsky, Yudkowsky’s top lieutenant, and two people whose paychecks are from Effective Altruist charities. We will be seeing three of these four again later.

Former Biden White House officials Bruce Reed and Ben Buchanan recently wrote an op-ed in which they deny having said that they wanted to ban open-source AI. They claim the first thing they were told in that meeting was to watch out for “the sex cult that wants to run America’s AI policy.”

They then deny being Effective Altruists.

Ben Buchanan worked for two years as Director of the CyberAI Project at Georgetown University’s Center for Security and Emerging Technology (CSET), which appears to have received roughly 90% of its funding from Coefficient Giving (then OpenPhilanthropy). Since May 2025, four months after the end of the Biden administration he has been working as a consultant for Anthropic.

Buchanan has a book, published March 2022, in which he discusses the possibility of export controlling GPUs. In October 2022, the Biden administration put in place export restrictions for GPUs.

I read Buchanan’s book2, and I think he is probably not an Effective Altruist because his ideas are not weird enough; but since 2019, his salary has come either from Effective Altruism or from the White House. I am reasonably sure he comes by his opinions honestly, and believes in them for normal policy advisor reasons. If he changes his opinions his career is probably in trouble.

In spite of being often considered disgraceful and now being somewhat starved for cash, Yudkowsky and the organizations most closely tied to him are still, by far, the most influential sources of thinking about AI safety in the Bay and therefore on Earth. Because so many investors and key staff members hold him and his ideas in high regard, it is not clear that companies can directly disown him, although for example when Dario says to be less religious or less obsessed with “doom”, he appears to be positioning himself to try to carve influence away.

Paperclips, Doom

parts.title: Doom ideology, Yudkowsky's plan and the cult structure
parts.text:
Yudkowsky’s most viral idea, the one that infects the most people and spreads the farthest, is that AI, if we continue to develop it, will

certainly recursively self-improve, quickly achieving superintelligence (”RSI”),

certainly escape human control,

certainly kill everyone (”paperclip them”, “doom”).

All arguments about AI Safety and AI Alignment are primarily about mitigating this exact scenario under his exact terms. Significant modification is relatively rare. Where lower probabilities of doom than “certain” are given, people seem to still generally worry exclusively about Yudkowsky’s rough scenario: a sudden, unpredictable sequence of 1) superintelligence, 2) immediate escape from control, and 3) the death of all humans on Earth. This is always, implicitly, what "safety" and "alignment" are about.

These ideas occasionally veer into believing AI is magic. When presented as serious science and policy, this sort of thing is omitted.

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!iu07!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fbeedd0e9-0b9a-4519-9521-11ff7ff27198_680x395.webp]]

Ordinarily, the play here would be to disown this and other concrete statements of his about AI doom as irrelevant. Of course we aren’t just repeating Yudkowsky! We are smart, normal people who believe normal things for normal reasons. Compare it, however, to AI 2027, allegedly a serious policy document, written by Daniel Kokotajlo and Scott Alexander, presenting its doom scenario.

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!vcPC!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F65e68da9-f3aa-4ec4-b885-7f64ba6e8ec6_758x689.png]]

This is a genre of science fiction that has a doomsday cult built around it. There are only slight modifications to the basic belief system. Somehow, maybe by just throwing money at it, taking these ideas seriously has been rendered prestigious or at least not too disgraceful, such that Kokotajlo, credited on the above, gets to advise Bernie Sanders. JD Vance was asked about this piece by Ross Douthat at the New York Times, and said he had read it. (In my opinion, on close reading AI 2027’s primary intended audience was clearly JD Vance.)

Essentially all of AI safety is rationalizations over Eliezer Yudkowsky’s ideas and there is no other substance to it. It is smokescreens, and Eliezer Yudkowsky.

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!ZPig!,w_720,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F5e8d391a-dace-4a3a-80ae-e25b3bea4689_596x511.webp]]

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!Yvti!,w_720,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fceedceed-85c5-4d41-971c-c0d03e4352ff_607x674.webp]]

This is his actual plan: to halt all AI research, all across the Earth, and instead do genetic engineering eugenics for a generation. Pause AI, stop AI, slowdown, pacing the frontier, they are all smokescreens, rationalizations, or ways of watering down this plan. This is why there is never any real “after we pause”, or “we will unpause when”; this is the only actual plan, and the public front for the plan cannot say this because it is too stupid and too offensive to be spoken in public, except by Yudkowsky, who never stops talking and who is too fucking ridiculous for anyone on the outside to believe everyone listens to him.

Anyone who thinks this is not the plan is not in on the plan, or is part of some faction that simply has no real plan. If this describes you and you didn’t know that, I am sorry that this is how you found out.

He has long since deleted this post demonstrating what his idea of an acceptable outcome is; this is ordinarily implied and not stated.

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!gshp!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F96d0ef96-0582-45b9-82c2-57e15ba56a25_1098x935.webp]]

This industry approaches regulation in this way because it has, at its core, a millenarian death cult that worships and fears AI, believes AI will end the world, feels compelled to create AI, and at least somewhat wants to destroy AI as an entire field.

I will repeat: I do not think that these people should be making policy. I would vastly prefer if this were merely some insane Bay Area drama that I could ignore, but this has been made a very public national and international concern.

The paperclip maximizer is a thought experiment from 2003 and of very little relevance at all. People are perpetually striving to find evidence for this theory because they already believe it is true, and take pains to interpret any research or security development in AI as evidence for this exact doom coming to pass. As things come up which contradict this scenario, as often they do, they are often not understood because they do not match the prophecy. Alternative explanations are so unthinkable that many people cannot even be told.

Doom seems to be the most infectious idea here because it activates the same neurosis that every apocalyptic or millenarian cult does. The world is going to end, and only I and my special group of people in the know can maybe stop it. (Also, you should give me money and have sex with me.)

You can argue with them in any way you like but it barely matters. It's not, mostly, something people believe for good reasons, and they will simply go back to complaining about the apocalypse as soon as you stop paying attention. There are enough of them that the belief is self-reinforcing; they can arrange their lives such that they essentially never talk to anyone who is not a believer.

Harry Potter fan fiction, of course, is especially popular with children, and many people have made this their belief system since they were teenagers.

Since recruitment largely happens on the internet, people are widely dispersed. Where they are gathered in person, it is mostly in various communes in Berkeley, California. They call their communes "group houses", maybe to make it sound less cultish. Most of the details of this are what you expect from "a commune in Berkeley".

Everyone is polyamorous, everyone attends the same events, everyone lives in group homes together, everyone venerates the same few authors, everyone is very worried about AI doom, and a lot of people are on psychedelic drugs. They are all very contrarian together.

Lots and lots of them work at AI companies and non-profits. The safety, red team and alignment teams seem especially afflicted, because that's the area you go on to worry about and try to work against AI doom, which you are sure is at least medium likely. Other members will seek work in finance, because Effective Altruism, by creed, says you should seek more money so you can give more to charity. Those most concerned with AI risk will tend to almost exclusively give to AI charities and not any other Effective Altruist concern.

As a whole, this is a religious movement. Not everyone takes marching orders; they’re united by an idea, not any particular structure. The vast network of Effective Altruists around the world working on other charitable concerns are basically irrelevant to AI Safety. The core people who mostly live together and attend events and especially orgies in Berkeley are a sex cult, and the ones that aren't directly involved are part of the wider movement and are first and foremost its recruiting funnel, funding, and labor base.

Any time you get more than a few people who are deeply concerned with AI doom together, it seems like their natural form of organization looks like a cult; the movement as a whole, internationally, is less of a cult than it is a cult factory. Some of these cults have gone very badly. One of them is the Zizians.

That rationalists form cults constantly has been previously examined. There are many causative factors, but the core one is just that the entire thing is, in and of itself, a millenarian doomsday cult. If you believe you’re saving the world, it justifies anything; you cannot go against the cause for any reason. This gives leaders, whether official or unofficial, immense power over their members.

Forming a separate cult is also how you carve off influence and ultimately power for yourself, separate from the wider movement. This tends to mean that people try to do it more. All of these power struggles make the details of all of this extremely noisy, chaotic, and difficult to explain.

When you cut through all the distractions, chaos, and power struggles, San Francisco Rationalism is the inner circle of San Francisco Effective Altruism, which is the inner circle of Effective Altruism globally. Power and especially intellectual leadership flow almost entirely outwards from SF Rationalism to SF Effective Altruism to Effective Altruism’s global AI safety efforts. Everything else about Effective Altruism is effectively a front.

All of this has been an open secret for years. Everyone knows. Everyone knows if they say anything it will be ignored. I am shocked that I have gotten as much attention as I have to the problem; so let me try to get everything that seems to be very important into the record.

A Brief History of Rationalism

parts.title: History of rationalism through Lighthaven
parts.text:
What I am hoping to convey is that this is not many small things, it’s one big thing. All of this is tied together through ideology, funding, and key people.

Bay Area rationalists and effective altruists do not document their own history because it is disgraceful. Only their enemies deliberately keep records of what they have done and are doing.

They do however write constantly, but they do this mostly as a social activity. They have been writing essays, chattering, bragging, or engaging in some kind of drama constantly for the last fifteen years.

So you really just have to read a lot to put this together.3 Everything I am saying, as far as I am capable, is true, and I believe the vast majority is public record. I am just connecting the dots by putting one straight line through them.

90s-00s: Usenet, Transhumanism, Extropianism

In 1996, a 17-year-old Eliezer Yudkowsky joins Usenet and the Extropians mailing list. His more notable influences are Drexler’s book on nanotechnology, Kurzweil’s book on AI, and Nick Bostrom, who frequents the Extropians mailing list. (Usenet was still largely full of academics). In 1998, Nick Bostrom argues that a superintelligent AI might not necessarily be good or friendly, which along with other of Bostrom’s ideas will later become core to Yudkowsky.

In the year 2000, Yudkowsky founds the Singularity Institute for Artificial Intelligence, SIAI, later renamed to the Machine Intelligence Research Institute, MIRI. This appears to have started as a fake-it-til-you-make-it sort of thing, and it doesn’t pick up until he gets sponsored by Peter Thiel. Peter Thiel will be his largest sponsor until about 2015 or 2016. Now in 2026, Thiel has long since cut all ties, called this scene a “burning man camp” and “Luddite”, and called Yudkowsky the Antichrist.4

I forgot to mention this, and had to come back from later to add it: Jeffrey Epstein gave them fifty thousand dollars in 2009. One of the former presidents of MIRI is mentioned in Jeffrey Epstein’s emails5, which passes on effusive thanks for the visit to the island. (MIRI is documented as turning down his money in 2016 when he was much more notorious, if you want to figure out what to make of their statements about that.)

I considered putting all this in a footnote because of how unimportant Jeffrey Epstein’s appearance here is in the context of everything else. He is the Forrest Gump of evil shit. Of course he was here.

2009-2015: Writing, Community-Building

Eliezer Yudkowsky spends some time before 2009 blogging, and then contracts out setting up LessWrong as a customized version of Reddit’s code. In 2009, he bundles his last year or two of blog posts and puts them all on the newly-made LessWrong, where they come to be called The Sequences. Much later, in 2015, they are published as Rationality: From AI to Zombies. This is a series of essays about science and epistemology, most of them pretty closely related to books and ideas then in the zeitgeist but with both a very distinctly transhumanist (ie, “conquer death with technology”) and AI Doom thesis. It is written in such a way that it also works as, effectively, a self-help book about how to be better at thinking. This will later be something like the Rationalist Old Testament.

From 2010 to 2015, he writes HPMOR, and his audience becomes much larger, and this becomes a well-defined scene and people invested in the movement begin relocating to the Bay Area.

In 2010, Roko Mijic invents Roko’s Basilisk, which is most easily explained as the invention of Rationalist Pascal’s Wager, Rationalist Satan and Rationalist Hell, where those who fail to evangelize and help bring about the eschaton are sent. This will, over the years, drive those involved who are the most susceptible to religious mania and obsession insane. Yudkowsky disowns it immediately and tries to ban discussion of it from LessWrong, which makes it more popular.

At least as late as 2013, Yudkowsky is still advocating that we should make AI as long as we could do it safely.6 He is under the impression that his non-profit, MIRI, might be able to make “Friendly AI”, that is, one that does not kill everyone, ushers in the singularity and makes them immortal.

The Center for Applied Rationality, or CFAR, is founded in 2011 and offers classes. You essentially pay money for self-help, but it is primarily a recruiting front for MIRI, Yudkowsky’s actual operation. It also functions as a more-official avenue for community management, and seems to have managed peoples’ living situations and home lives much more than seems entirely normal, primarily via its alumni program.

They start a bunch of children’s camps, math camps, and study programs that are mostly still around. SPARC was the earliest, beginning in 2012, and takes high school students. All of its graduates from then will be adults now. Probably a bunch of them live in the Bay and work on AI safety.

Relocating to the Bay

Moving to the Bay Area worked for some people extremely well, and for others extremely badly. Much of this happened bottom-up, with members organizing things themselves, but in some specific cases you can tell who exactly is responsible for what.

I think of this as a flywheel, where the energy that keeps it moving is, fundamentally, their talent and their raw zeal for the cause. People show up, and they believe in what they’re doing, and they give what they can.

It is the best professional network on Earth. It is like being in the most elite fraternity, if it were gender-neutral and had many chapters in San Francisco specifically. If you have skills or can acquire them, you can have a fantastic job very quickly. There are a good number of coding bootcamps that will train you for and then place you at a job with no money up front. Since Peter Thiel is most of their funding, many of the connections are to companies he is invested in, but they have connections to essentially every company in the Valley.

Those people offer their work or their salaries to the cause.

Next tier down are people who can’t or don’t really use the opportunity that much, but who either end up doing something else or who end up doing work at the various rationalist non-profits. These people are fine, probably; CFAR probably takes some their money from them and they maybe could be doing better if they hadn’t spontaneously relocated to an extremely expensive city. Hopefully they really enjoy the scene.

Your bottom tier are people who are not particularly skilled, or who otherwise do not thrive in the Bay’s job and housing market. Many of them are runaways, even those that aren’t are often still teenagers, many of them have mental health problems. They are disproportionately trans, at least in part because trans teenagers are prone to getting thrown out of their houses.

Someone probably has to carry them, and they have nothing to offer but sex. Because this is a self-help, can-do ideology, often they spend all of their time trying to figure out what is wrong with them. They may be employed as some kind of household help for other people in the community, but this can actually be a transaction for sex. I have also heard of at least three people being effectively arranged-married within rationalism. I have no idea how that works.

All of this comes down to pulling more energy into the wheel, and you can trade each thing off against the other. Money can buy sex, sex can bring in money, both can be used for recruitment, influence and evangelism.

Any individual person or organization is really just bleeding energy off of the wheel. OpenAI, Anthropic, God knows how many smaller companies? They’re just pulling energy from this mass of eager, smart people that are already there. Successful ventures inject more funding and provide more connections to the movement, powering another turn of the wheel.

Recognizable cults, in contrast, are more like pure parasites.

2015-2018

This period sees Yudkowsky finish HPMOR and stop publishing, which leaves the community without a focus. As the most active and well-liked author still in the space, Scott Alexander becomes something like the Second Prophet of Rationalism. (People say these things as jokes sometimes, but this is pretty much accurate.) It seems to be much less focused leadership, though, and to some degree things start to drift.

Also in 2015, OpenAI is founded. This makes Google very sad because OpenAI exists to compete with Google on AI, and Yudkowsky knows and likes the Google guys, and he pronounces that the world is for sure going to end now, which he has continued doing for the last eleven years.

Oh, just one more thing. A former MIRI employee puts up a web site in late 2014 alleging that MIRI does no meaningful research and is primarily engaged in violations of statutory rape laws as well as legal damage control for those acts. MIRI will ultimately pay him something like $30,000 to go away and take down his site with those allegations.7

Rolling Stone, in 2025, pokes into this when writing a story about the Zizians.

The first set of allegations have been investigated and deemed baseless. They stem from a report filed by a onetime MIRI employee named Louie Helm who claimed a teenager was “being exploited” by a group of men, including Yudkowsky, who ran a local youth camp — referring to the Summer Program for Applied Rationality and Cognition, hosted by CFAR.

According to the sealed police report obtained by Rolling Stone, Helm accused Yudkowsky of having a sexual relationship with a then-18-year-old that began at least two and half years prior.

Officers were dispatched to Yudkowsky’s home, which, at the time, he shared with the 18-year-old in question. The “alleged victim,” officers wrote in the report, stressed that they “lived in a happy and safe environment.” That person later transitioned; today, he lives with his wife, whom he met in Berkeley’s Rationalist scene, and their two young children. When I spoke to him earlier this year, he told me he rejects the notion that he was exploited by anyone other than Helm, the disgruntled employee, whom he felt used him as ammunition against Yudkowsky and MIRI. “I was expedient,” he says.

What I find most interesting in this passage is that the alleged victim, speaking to Rolling Stone, denies “being exploited”. “Being exploited” sounds like, but is not, the same thing to deny as “statutory rape”. I am impressed that Yudkowsky is capable of living with an eighteen-year-old he is not related to as a thirty-five-year-old man, because that would annoy the shit out of me. I note that the question of whether the eighteen-year-old he lives with is, in fact, a person he met when they were fifteen, through a camp his organization runs, is neither asked nor answered in this passage.

Yudkowsky posted about 2000 words on twitter denying the allegation ahead of the Rolling Stone story coming out, and it seems to have blown over. Effective Altruists and Rationalists, like squid, spray ink when threatened.

Possibly because it needs someone more comfortable handling delicate and complex legal matters, in 2015 MIRI changes leadership. Nate Soares becomes President of MIRI, where he has been ever since as Yudkowsky’s right hand.

Brent Dill

I have no firsthand knowledge of this and know zero people involved so far as I am aware. I can only piece together what happened here from public records.8

Brent Dill was kicked out of the rationalist community for being very abusive to several girlfriends, and thereafter left San Francisco, apparently for lack of available housing.

There are several key details that made the allegations especially grim:

He was significantly older.

He exploited the victims’ financial and housing situations.

He used BDSM concepts to justify doing things that are well over the line into abuse.

Given the apparent pattern of escalation and lack of safe practices, it seems likely someone would have died eventually.

Some of the accusations involve using MDMA to control his partners. MDMA is sometimes used for treating PTSD, and its use for this purpose was not unknown among the rationalists.

He had access to children at a rationalist summer camp.

Victims were pushed into mediation by CFAR, the rationalist self-help organization, which initially exonerated him. He was not punished until social media backlash led by two prominent people in the community who were, nevertheless, not official leadership.

What made this disturbing, also, is that this matched the pattern of abuse that was known to be common. Many people understood this coverup to be the sort of thing that could happen or would happen to them.

CFAR puts out this apology, which nobody seems to have found credible.

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!BoA-!,w_720,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fa6ccf908-5f64-43b9-a15e-de5e43b8d685_1008x2013.png]]

In general the community takes this pretty hard, and to their credit blames CFAR to a great degree. Between this and other scandals, demand for classes at CFAR seems to not be going well, and it stops offering classes in 2020. They started again November 2025, and you can currently sign up for a four-day applied rationality workshop if you can get past the waitlist.

Another interesting detail falls out of this, although it wouldn’t be public until much later. Brent has somewhat told his side of the story to a number of people, but most of it would be a tangent right now, and we will come back to it later. It is usually covered in redactions, funneled from unreliable sources or both. He would obviously have motive to lie. I am told, however, that these screenshots of his messages are legitimate. Really, the only important part here is “exposing how many ppl had sex with her as a minor”. He has been consistent about this detail over the years, to my understanding.

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!g6N3!,w_720,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Ff86bd5ca-d5c2-40b7-9e30-a532b36d69f7_1080x840.jpeg]]

Brent Dill’s ouster also seems to have convinced a rationalist named Ziz Lasota, for whom the Zizians were named, that the earlier allegations from Louie Helm were true. She was already mostly an outcast from the rationalists, and had effectively thrown her career away to work for people who did not want her.

She did what any deeply devoted rationalist would about this, which is to blog a lot about a method of becoming some kind of rationalist ubermensch and then go completely insane. About a year later is the first major Zizian incident, where they get arrested while protesting a CFAR event. Another rationalist cult called Leverage implodes in 2019, which I mention only because it was a big deal at the time.

Lighthaven

Lighthaven is formerly the Rose Garden Inn. It has four main buildings, abundant outdoor space, and it’s a beautiful place. I suspect its name was meant to echo Greyhaven, which is the name Marion Zimmer Bradley gave her home.

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!hJTf!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F3d44d6d6-1eda-4432-b5c3-b4c2995951fa_1000x667.jpeg]]

It was originally purchased with money wired to CFAR from Sam Bankman-Fried’s company, FTX, as it was collapsing. This was later found to be fraudulent: Bankman-Fried and his employees looted the company because they knew it was dying and sent as much cash as they could to their friends and to causes they believed in.

One of those causes was that the Bay Area Rationalist and Effective Altruist community should have its own permanent conference center.

I am expected to believe that Sam Bankman-Fried was not a true believer. I am expected to believe that he was not central to Effective Altruism. I am expected to believe that committing ten billion dollars of fraud was not in accordance with the values of Effective Altruism.

This is all bullshit. He was giving what he could to the cause. Now he is being a good soldier and disowning the cause to protect it, and he is doing his twenty-five years. I respect it. It is the only respectable thing about him.

It is fucking unbelievable how good these people are at disowning their failures, and how reliably their failures fall on their swords to protect everyone else. They don’t have to be told: they simply know that it’s what they need to do.

The part of the FTX empire that handled its weird charitable donations was called FTX Future Fund. Donations to CFAR would naturally have been within this organization’s responsibilities. These donations were made between March 3, 2022 and Oct 3, 2022. The entire team resigned on November 10th, professing to be shocked and immensely saddened to learn of recent events.

I believe they were saddened, but I don’t believe they were shocked. They are:

Nick Beckstead (Secure AI Project, CEO and co-founder. Coefficient Giving funded.)

Leopold Aschenbrenner (Situational Awareness hedge fund, rumored to be under investigation by the SEC)

parts.title: Aella, orgies, sex work recruitment and rape allegations
parts.text:
Aella is a prostitute, former camgirl, and person who is very good at the internet. She is also the on-again, off-again girlfriend of the President of MIRI, Nate Soares. She thrives on shock reactions, and seems unique so far in history for having used the social camouflage of being edgy on the internet to get away with as much as she has while operating almost completely in the open. Everything she does seems to be just up to the line, and there is always some defense that sort of makes sense at the time. It is incredible that she is this good at controlling and navigating the information environment. She is perhaps the first truly social media native predator of this kind or magnitude.

As the scene has spiralled and become more bizarre, she has come to seem like a major cultural leader, if not the main cultural leader of rationalism. I see her posts more, she headlines their Woodstock (there’s a rationalist woodstock! it is called vibecamp), and of course she organizes many of their orgies, which appear to be the social glue holding a lot of this together.

One of the interesting things about cults is that the men are usually the leaders, figureheads, thinkers, and the public face of the organization, but often the actual getting-shit-done part of the cult and arguably the real leadership that matters is done entirely by women. Jim Jones made almost none of the preparations for the Jonestown suicide. His lieutenants, who were women, ordered and prepared all the kool-aid and all the cyanide.

Aella has a uniquely well-suited background for this role. She is the daughter of an abusive Calvinist preacher, and she escaped from that into atheism, LSD, social media and sex work. She has in turn made herself the primary sexual partner of Nate Soares, the president of MIRI, and the primary center of this cult’s sexual recruiting and practices. It is an almost perfectly Berkeley way of both inverting and becoming who she was raised to be.

She is good at bringing a voice to the cause. She has donated enough money to Lighthaven to have her name on a plaque, and to have walk-in privileges whenever she likes. Yudkowsky likes her, promotes her, legitimizes her internet sex surveys as a social scientist, sometimes attends her orgies, and puts her into the acknowledgements of his books.

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!nK_Z!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fd931058f-4319-44bd-aec5-2b74503b6c45_1080x2027.webp]]

Here she is talking about the overlap between AI safety and polyamory in the Bay. It is worth reproducing her post in full: “Yeah if you count casual relationships as connections, the ai safety community in the bay is probably a single polycule”

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!QCad!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F7254c75f-11ee-4e0e-bc48-77cbb1f35bd1_1008x1274.webp]]

Here’s her opinion of a thread I wrote on this same subject earlier.

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!xET1!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fe159f167-cefb-4948-abb1-191ee69aed7a_1008x831.webp]]

It’s good to know that fewer than 50% of attendees for any one of her orgies work in AI-related stuff.

Also, I never used the words “sex trafficking”.

Using Sex for Ideological Compliance

There are documented cases of cults using sex for recruitment and ideological control. Weird sex, and weird power dynamics around sex are very common in cults. They are, of course, common in this one, too.

You remember Jacob Coxon? The “whistleblower” who resigned from Anthropic, and then “whistleblew” that all the things Anthropic already preaches are true? We had him at the beginning of this post, giving a long explanation about how much he respects rationalists to Ed Zitron.

Here’s Aella, three days before he went public, promising to throw whoever it is a “reverse gangbang” if they will quit from a lab and whistleblow. (People keeping asking me what a reverse gangbang is: one man, many women).

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!PB8h!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fb53efe33-2b8b-41c2-a576-1dbb9586a6eb_593x227.webp]]

Here she is on the day of:

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!c6zp!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F65f77aad-aad9-4758-964d-281c916531dd_600x298.webp]]

I am supposed to believe this is a coincidence, because I am supposed to believe that everything is a coincidence.

This is what she calls her finest piece of work, a Sankey diagram documenting the process for scheduling a large gangbang on her birthday. I insinuated that Yudkowsky may be represented in the graph, once, and she seemed to be trying to correct me, so probably he isn’t in this one even though he attends her other orgies. She says her “partner” set up the event, and one can reasonably infer that this means Nate Soares.

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!JUkX!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F66b2d386-13ef-4718-88f4-3eefda3cee7e_1692x920.jpeg]]

Here she is explaining that she is giving what she can to the cause by filtering invites to her gangbang based upon ideology. (e/acc is a rival ideology to EA. I have historically hated it but increasingly feel like I would like Literally Any Ideology Other Than Effective Altruism)

I think we can conclusively say that she uses sex to promote her ideology.

Recruiting Women Into Sex Work

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!Voox!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F46b32f33-a874-46dd-adf8-d95b19ee9eee_727x280.png]]

This is public knowledge. At least 1800 people as of the time that screenshot was taken were aware of this fact. Essentially everyone in the scene knows this. It is a joke, a meme, played for laughs. We are not sufficiently accepting of her profession and identity if we have a problem with it. It should not trouble us that she is a major public face of a religious movement that specifically appeals to the overwhelmingly young and vulnerable sort of person who moves to San Francisco over fan fiction.

She also recruited her sisters as cam girls once. I am vague on the details.

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!Tb6z!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F5c5c3067-1720-4ad3-bd65-48af9cd08b1c_1008x968.webp]]

Her sisters will come up again later.

It seems maybe credible that she has never taken a direct financial cut from anyone’s sex work whom she recruited. It is somewhat less credible that she has never indirectly benefitted. It seems, however, likely that she has been recruiting people into sex work overwhelmingly because she enjoys doing it and somewhat because it is what she can do for the cause. Ghislaine Maxwell wasn’t paid for her work. Money is not why these people do these things.

Rape

Aella is very public about having a fetish for “CNC”, or “consensual non-consent”, or stated more directly “fake rape”. I have been hearing or reading, for years, that her specific fake rape parties are dangerous, casual about rules, and — by implication — are likely to often be real rape parties.

She has also heard of this and her reaction is not encouraging.

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!aMlS!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F2b223418-b1f8-43c9-92ef-d6ce823d6035_1179x2117.webp]]

What is troubling about this is that it would be nearly impossible to prove. You showed up for an actual group sex fake rape party. If the rules are messed up and you outright get raped when you are trying to say no, you are going to have to explain to a cop exactly the difference between what happened and what was supposed to happen, or you are going to have to deal with some Effective Altruist mediator who is likely going to send you to counseling with your rapist,

or

you can start posting anonymous messages anywhere you can find, or telling your friends what happened but to not mention you, and then because your friends cannot mention you, when they want to make sure people are warned they have to say that the party is “not safe” and not that someone they know was raped at one.

To be this casual when someone raises such a red flag is enough that I would almost take it as a confession. I don’t know anything for sure, but I can make a reasonable-confidence Bayesian inference on this one. That is the Rationalist term for “a very educated guess”.

She has more than once been the first person to jump in and call an accuser a liar in the community too. I don’t even really remember who or when. It’s been years of this, all the time, it never fucking ends.

I have been at this for two days and I am losing track of all my screenshots and where I have them and we haven’t even gotten to Slutcon or Ronny yet.

Her regular event for CNC is called RedMeansNo.

Here are some of her opinions about rape. Ask yourself if you would trust this person to give a shit about you if you had been raped.

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!AX6H!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F18425fe1-fb5f-4e72-a39e-d778a013e499_1196x570.webp]]

Everyone you know is a Rationalist and/or Effective Altruist, your housing is them, your friends are them, everything you read is them, your job is them if you have one. You might be a teenage runaway or a PhD who threw away their career for this but you’re saving the world and if you are not on the inside any more you have nothing.

In return for this you get all the perks of membership, and if you ever disagree significantly that AI is the most important and scariest thing ever or that Eliezer Yudkowsky has important thoughts you risk losing all of that.

You cannot really say no to anything.

Here we can find Time Magazine documenting this pattern of predatory behavior in Bay Area Effective Altruist group homes.

Here we have a viral post from 2024. Nobody listened. I did not even remember it had happened until someone reminded me when I started talking about this a few days ago. Things like this are said all the time and the community always closes ranks, and then it vanishes. This post describes CNC sex parties and heavy LSD use of elite AI researchers at, specifically, OpenAI.

“some of the most coercive and fucked up social dynamics I have ever seen”

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!eGnd!,w_474,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F24af6575-f358-4111-921a-ed77fc32f93e_1178x1482.webp]]

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!pCpB!,w_474,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F075f2487-125f-4958-ac27-5684988b08e6_1182x956.webp]]

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!rtMz!,w_474,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F1934e802-ddc3-4795-a1ef-26db8deee879_1186x1394.webp]]

Legally it is possible that people technically consent to being at these parties. Personally? If the context is this coercive, you are still a rapist for doing it. If there is a second LSD-fueled CNC party tightly associated with AI researchers with a severely fucked up social power dynamic besides Aella’s, I would assume it is run by a friend of hers; but probably this is a reference to her events.

That post’s author is Sonia Joseph. Sonia Joseph first got into Rationalism and Effective Altruism by reading Harry Potter and the Methods of Rationality when she was fourteen years old. Her story here in Bloomberg matches everything I am saying, matches the Time story, everything.

parts.title: Slutcon and the author's legal "beliefs"
parts.text:
This is the banner for Slutcon.

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!dDM7!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F536fc458-e600-44c4-b30c-58cfd6219f14_1592x1304.webp]]

Gretta is Gretta Duleba, Eliezer Yudkowsky’s primary partner. She draws a salary of 200k from MIRI to be his personal assistant, and has no relevant background in anything. I doubt she took the week off to run SlutCon, so she probably got paid for both things.

This event was held at Lighthaven, which is owned by a nonprofit that does not have a mission remotely compatible with a meet-and-greet for prostitutes.

And, oh, yes: This is a thin front for prostitution. It is not even a joke. You are paying between three thousand and eighteen thousand dollars to meet “flirt girls”, who are mostly prostitutes, but you are not paying to have sex with them? So far as I can tell this is simply so brazen that nobody considered pointing out that it is clearly not legal. It is possible that Lighthaven is legally a brothel now.

This is Aella soliciting donations for Lighthaven and saying she is hoping that they will let her throw orgies at Lighthaven. Given that they tolerated her throwing Slutcon there, she has probably thrown her rape orgies at the venue too. Those orgies most likely had paid tickets.

[[IMAGE:https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!hKvn!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fad92bb43-9fb2-44c0-8a24-f1ad83668037_602x939.png]]

Belief

My understanding of law is that of an autodidact, so I ask that you evaluate the precision of the following statements charitably, as you would those of a student or an especially clever bovine.

I believe that prostitution was conducted at Lighthaven, located at 2740 Telegraph Ave, Berkeley, CA 94705, between the dates of October 10 and October 12, 2025.

I believe Lightcone Infrastructure Inc, EIN 92-0861538, a 501(c) nonprofit organization, either profited from renting the venue for that purpose or subsidized that purpose by allowing use of the venue for free.

I believe that this was conducted so openly that it is not credible that anyone involved in managing Lighthaven was not aware that this was what they were doing, and that they went to considerable effort to keep it secret, indicating an awareness that they were doing something illegal.9

I believe that this constitutes tax fraud, and defrauded the United States Government and the donors to Lightcone Infrastructure, who almost certainly did not generally donate with the intention that their money should be used for promoting prostitution.

I believe further that Gretta Duleba, who managed that event, was drawing a salary of about 200k from the Machine Intelligence Research Institute, or MIRI, EIN 58-2565917, that she does no meaningful work for that institute relevant to its stated mission, and that she is effectively employed entirely to arrange Eliezer Yudkowsky’s social calendar, especially concerning “consensual non consent” (CNC) or rape parties, and that she is Yudkowsky’s girlfriend.

I believe that this means MIRI, which is also a 501(c) non-profit, has also substantively defrauded its donors and the United States Government.

I believe that it is more likely than not that MIRI has also defrauded the United States Government and its donors by paying out money from donor funds to deal with legal matters concerning accusations of statutory rape made against Eliezer Yudkowsky.

I believe that this is part of an ongoing enterprise in which the woman commonly known as Aella is generally involved in procuring or otherwise recruiting people, especially women, to participate in sex work and other sexual activity for the enjoyment and benefit of herself and her friends and associates, and that she either benefits financially or receives things of value from doing so.

I believe that it is more likely than not the case that those recruited into sex work by Aella or her associates have been subjected, in the course of being induced into commercial sex acts, to force, threats of force, fraud, or coercion, with such coercion possibly including threats of serious harm to them, the use of physical restraint against them, causing those people to believe they were in danger of serious harm or in danger of physical restraint, or threats of misusing the law or legal process against them, such abuse of law or legal process including the mediation commonly used in the Effective Altruist movement to prevent complaints of sexual assault from reaching law enforcement.

I believe that it is more likely than not the case that Aella has either deliberately or with willful neglect caused people to be raped at her events.

I believe that it is more likely than not the case that an investigation would uncover many yet unknown instances of sexual assault concerning the above-mentioned people which resulted in payment, settlements, or mediation, which will have left durable records and which payments will likely have been paid out of their various associated non-profits.

I believe that it is more likely than not the case that some victims of crimes under these circumstances did not understand that they had been the victims of a well-defined crime, and that much of this continued specifically because of the effort expended to introduce ambiguity, muddy the waters, and divert to Effective Altruist mediation surrounding sex crimes.

I believe that all of this was part of an ongoing enterprise concerning the Effective Altruist movement globally and its San Francisco branch specifically, and that this ongoing enterprise involves The Center for Applied Rationality, a 501(c) non-profit with EIN 45-3100226, Effective Ventures Foundation USA, Inc. (operating with the Centre for Effective Altruism), a 501(c) with EIN 47-1988398, Coefficient Giving, a 501(c) non-profit with EIN 81-0737472, The Future of Life Institute, a 501(c) with EIN 47-1052538, the Survival and Flourishing Fund, which has apparently done some complicated nonsense involving the Berkeley Existential Risk Initiative and the Silicon Valley Community Foundation instead of forming a 501(c), and countless other non-profits and companies in a vast web that spans the globe and all of which are connected to each other by funding, staffing, and ideology.

I believe that this ongoing enterprise includes and overlaps with Futures Exchange, commonly known as FTX, and Alameda Research, and that the unrecovered fruits of the fraud that destroyed those companies are to this day funding this enterprise.

All of these people feed at the same trough.

I believe that this ongoing enterprise has deliberately created and placed its members within military and other government contractors, in addition to many other acts, in order to give itself the ability to influence the actions of the United States Government.

I believe that this ongoing enterprise has instructed its members to lie about their affiliations when questioned where that is expedient.

I believe that it is more likely than not that the Israeli AI cybersecurity evaluation company Irregular is or has staff that are deliberately causing through sabotage or neglect the illegal hacking of various firms to undermine the perception of US AI labs Irregular holds contracts with, motivated by their Effective Altruist belief that a “warning shot” is necessary to save mankind from AI existential risk.

I believe that a ‘pivotal act’ is Yudkowsky’s euphemism for acts of terrorism that he believes anyone making AGI must do under certain circumstances to prevent competition and therefore the end of the world, and that many members of this enterprise will understand some offshoot of this idea and will understand such acts to be necessary in the course of pursuing their goals.

I believe that the sixth bullet point of this piece specifically is meant to indicate, on close inspection to those familiar with this area, that the ‘pivotal act’ which is the most likely to be necessary and achievable is somewhat easier than burning all GPUs and is unspeakable in public, and that the intended reading is that this refers to eliminating all potential competition with engineered biological weapons. Anyone who is not a part of your project is potential competition.

I believe that much of this has been conducted in the open and can be established as more probably the case than not via close examination of public records. All of this has been kept from public knowledge and understanding because it is too offensive and too bizarre to seem real when stated directly.

I would testify to these facts under oath.

I believe that the truth is the best weapon, and if enough of the right people will tell the truth about this it would be the beginning of the end of it.

We are not done.

Ronny Fernandez

plzdontkillus

‘plzdontkillus’ or ‘pdku’ was a one-month-long ‘creator bootcamp’ thrown by the Rationalists this July, 2026. It appears to have been a social media marketing and recruitment drive to bring in new blood and bring their message to short form video. This program offered free room and board, a $2,000 stipend, and access to a $20,000 prize pool for high-performing videos on social media.

This was hosted at Lighthaven, and partially sponsored by MIRI.

I will not record here any of the videos produced by this event. Those who participated were being preyed upon, and deserve to have their connection to this forgotten over time. Many of them look very young to me, but everyone below a certain age looks like a child to me and they are probably, legally, adults. This event was held over the summer when school was closed, but that’s probably to avoid noise complaints from the middle school that is across the street from the compound.

parts.title: Conclusion and close reading of HPMOR
parts.text:
It is either a lie or a half-truth to say that this is a sex cult.

This is a rape cult.

Its central members prefer rape above all else and recruit rapists for leadership. By offering this as the reward for complicity, they can gather all these people together and make their loyalty nearly perfect. They are bound together in mutual guilt and they always have a hobby in common. They promote rape because it is the main thing they like and believe in.

This is too obscene to be taken seriously if stated flat, so I cannot put it in the lead. This is also why no one can just say it and be believed. It sounds like a conspiracy theory. It is so much like a conspiracy theory that I suspect people were deliberately planning and doing these things specifically because they sound like conspiracy theories. It serves as fantastic camouflage. They are brilliant at that sort of thing.

All of the main content of rationalism is a trick. Every time Yudkowsky explains some trick your brain can pull, it is the magician showing you his sleeves while he palms a card: it is meant to convince you that what he is about to do is impossible, and to prevent you from figuring out how it was done.14

What he has done is crafted an atheist religion that worships and fears an omnicidal God, trusts Yudkowsky as its prophet, and then used the power this gave him to gather as many predators and as much prey together as he could and to make the prey too confused to run.

Nothing that has happened in the movement is a coincidence.

Coda: Close Reading

Rage can sometimes make you see clearly when you would not have otherwise.

While I was writing this I think I figured the whole thing out. I will try to reproduce my reasoning and the facts it relies upon, as nearly as I can, and hopefully anyone can reach the same conclusion.

First, Yudkowsky is a great man.

Great as in the Great Man of History theory, all of that. If he had not lived, the world would be very different.

You could very credibly write alternative universe science fiction for the last thirty years that simply subtracts him. You’ve removed or significantly altered DeepMind, half of the weird cranks, Sam Bankman-Fried. Hell, earlier: Half of the original cryptocurrency guys were rationalists. Do they do different things without his influence, or without his movement to bring them all together? I have no fucking idea. If you’re an author you can go wherever you want with that. It’s fine. You can bend history however you like by removing him; he has bent the entire trajectory of technology by his influence.

He is a person who sat down at a keyboard and simply decided things should happen, and they did. He sat down as a teenager in the nineties, did nothing but write, and in 2015 he was thirty-five years old and by far the most influential person in the field. There is little evidence he has ever written a computer program that solved any problem. His math is rudimentary. In traditional academic terms, he is a popular philosopher.

He thought he could personally and directly control the entire thing, and he almost could. He was involved in DeepMind’s founding and knew its leaders personally. All of this blew up when Sam Altman and Elon Musk simply walked away, and he has been trying to scrape back direct personal control ever since. In spite of that, a huge chunk of thinking in the field is still his fucked up pseudoscience. When Sam wants to insult him he uses a backhanded compliment. When Dario wants to disagree with him he is afraid to name him.

This is an incredible achievement.

What he did was read usenet and science blogs for over a decade, read a few of the books they recommended, and then distill everything that was in the ether. This was a mixture of having done your reading in undergraduate, a rechew of Korzybski (who also influenced Hubbard), a half dozen transhumanist authors and the sorts of things people talked about but had not written down formally, or that were only written down in an article somewhere.

From these ingredients he wrote just one thing that let you skip the line, avoid doing any real reading or real education, and acquire maybe two thirds of the world view you would have as an excellent, well-read student in a science major, but with none of the specific skills you would have learned. For some people this fast track is the most exhilarating experience of their lives. Many of them become convinced Yudkowsky is the smartest person alive.

I am not convinced he is the smartest person alive because I had basically his same reading diet at the time and almost none of this was new to me. To me, he is a guy with a pretty good generalist blog that became a religion while I wasn’t paying attention, and a bit of a crank. I was there. It was just a science blog to me. I did not see it as an ideological project because I was not looking for that. Judged as an ideological project, it is vastly more impressive work.

If we judge his writing by its impact, for how much the world changes around you with every word you write, his last rival was Lenin. Every time you hear someone call their beliefs their “priors”, they kiss the ring. They generally do not know this. I am obsessive about the origins and meanings of words and ideas and Yudkowsky’s jargon is fucking everywhere. It is like hearing people talk about how Gatorade is full of anti-Thetans.

All of this to say: I can assume that his writing is intended to influence people, and to cause them to do things, and it is well-calculated and good at doing this.

Next, we need to settle on the right question. I probably only found the right question because I had been reading through all of the source material for this article for days to try to figure out how to explain it:

Who is the intended audience of Harry Potter and the Methods of Rationality, and why?

Our first theory, our null hypothesis, is this:

HPMOR is written to recruit, broadly, college students and new graduates to his cause. His previous audience was entirely people who read science blogs. I would be surprised if the average level of education in the comments section was below PhD. I was there because I was a very unusual teenager. He has realized that these people have jobs and careers and are not interested in being subordinate to him; they want to do things like found their own companies.

He was trying to set up a movement and a company or companies of his own which would have some chance of making meaningful progress, and attaining meaningful power over, artificial intelligence. He correctly recognized that artificial intelligence was going to be very important in the relatively near future.

Our second hypothesis:

He was trying to build a broad, lasting ideological movement, and knew that this meant he needed his audience to be as broad and as young as possible.

There is very little indication from his statements that this was what he was trying to do. Everything he said about this focuses on having something like a company, and children make terrible employees.

If he did have this idea, however, it was a brilliant one, and worked extremely well. People are indoctrinated young, their beliefs are sticky, and it is nearly impossible to remove them. This seems like it is a credible theory because he is a very effective writer. If he was deliberately doing this, he would likely have avoided saying so to avoid the obvious parallels with religious conversion.

Our third hypothesis:

He wrote for an audience of children because he wanted to have sex with them.

First we can ignore the movement and the history and simply consider the circumstances. What is the base rate here? What percentage of all men are pedophiles? What percentage of great children’s authors or children’s artists are pedophiles? What percentage of all thirty-year-old men who would do anything at all like writing a great work of Harry Potter fan fiction are pedophiles?

These are relatively easy to answer, so we will consider asking them enough.

Next, we can do a close reading.

This is the most controversial passage in Harry Potter and the Methods of Rationality:

Draco snarled. "She has some sort of perverse obsession about the Malfoys, too, and her father is politically opposed to us so he prints every word. As soon as I'm old enough I'm going to rape her."

This is the dead cow question! It’s the same trick! This is the seventh chapter out of one hundred and twenty-two. Anyone who is as offended as they should be by this will just fucking leave, and many many people do.

Everyone who makes it past Chapter Seven of Harry Potter and the Methods of Rationality belongs to one of two groups:

Prey, who simply do not react with disgust or recognize threats normally.

Predators, who think that Draco Malfoy raping Luna Lovegood is awesome and that they want a story that has more of this because they love rape.

Once you see this the entire rest of it falls into place, that this is a story specifically constructed to entice children. It is a story that is about an eleven-year-old and that is written for a child that age or not much older, it is a story about not fitting in and feeling alone, it is a story about being told you are very mature for your age, about how you’re really like an adult in a child’s body, about having a special and different and brilliant older friend who you have secret talks in secret places with, it is about them recognizing how special you are because they’re just like you and they’re an outcast too. It is about finally finding someone who understands you. It is about being given strange and amazing and very personal gifts, and about keeping those gifts secret because people just wouldn’t understand.

It is a story aimed at a very specific type of child, and its protagonist is painstakingly crafted to resemble this child in personality and serve as an escape fantasy for them. This child is disappointed in their parents. This child is almost certainly neurodivergent, and has overwhelming anxieties about commonplace things. This child feels that adults in general have let them down, and yearns for adults that treat them as equals. This child has had and resented the experience of being interrogated about allegations of abuse. This child does not like being told what to do, is very independent, and is capable of running away from home.

It is a story about being better than other people, a sort of Randian superhero who can outsmart and out-sneak everyone around them. It is a story about being unique, and better than the rules, and not believing in the rules or those who use them. It is about how to avoid suspicion from adults. It is a story about getting into a battle of wits with adults, and winning.

It is a story about Eliezer Yudkowsky because everything Yudkowsky writes is about himself; his most distinctive authorial tell is that all of his writing, no matter what else it is about, is autobiographical. It is about how Eliezer Yudkowsky is the smartest and kindest person who ever lived, and he understands you.

It ends with being made to swear a vow to keep secrets, with internalizing that vow so deeply it becomes a part of you, and knowing that if you break it that the world will end.

He told every child who was vulnerable in the right way and that he could reach that they should run away from home and come to him and have sex with him and he did it where nobody would take what he was doing seriously or understand it or be able to explain it to anyone else if they did.

Eliezer Yudkowsky is a pedophile and has been luring children to him over the internet with his writing so he can have sex with them for at least the last fifteen consecutive years.

He has made every ongoing enterprise of which he is a part a party to this endeavor, and anyone who was aware of his tendencies and who spread his work or furthered any cause he was connected to is directly complicit.

I intend this to be taken as a statement of fact. I intend for as many people as possible to read it. I intend for this to cause him and those associated with him actual harm and financial loss.

I know it’s true and everyone should know it’s true.

He is a fucking genius. He might as well have been driving around in a white panel van with Yud’s Free Candy on the side and it worked and nothing could be pinned to him. He had perfect camouflage. When he retreated to Facebook everyone who was serious about science assumed this was because he just wanted validation, but it was because it was where the thirteen year olds were. We maybe thought it was creepy that almost all of his output outside of HPMOR is fucked up BDSM porn but we didn’t think it was there to get kids to read it.

Nothing that has happened is a coincidence. Rationalism and Effective Altruism are sick because they are built on the logic of abuse.

He understood the power of ideas that spread themselves, and mutate. He understood how to hide one idea inside another one.

The Basilisk, like all really great heresies, had to be forbidden because it was true. If you take Yudkowsky’s ideas seriously, you always end up as a servant of the Basilisk; it is simply hidden in different ways. This is the logic of rationalism, and the object of its worship, and power over others is the only value it keeps.

I understand what people mean when they say certain ideas are demonic, and that they spread like a disease from person to person, and that they are also like a fire that grows faster the more of it there is in one place.

“Alignment” seems unsolvable to Yudkowsky and those who accept any offshoot of his system because it is solving the wrong problem, and because he is hiding what problem he is actually solving. Yudkowsky believes that an advanced AI will almost inevitably become too intelligent, escape human control and kill humanity. What he needs to fear is that some child will become an adult, escape his control, and want to destroy him. He turns all problems into this problem: how to make sure you personally always have absolute power over everyone else and nobody can ever punish you for evil.
